name: S7 - sharp vs dazed, the cancel war
description: Uncapped duality cancel is the whole reason for the two-levers law - feel whether the law is enough. Does the stack war feel like a FIGHT (reads, timing, bluffed sheds) or a coin flip decided by deck construction before turn 1? Did casting a shed ever feel like the best card in your hand - the removal economy is the only cap left, it has to earn that. NOTE: the pack offered 'a Sharp deck vs a Dazed applier, or the reverse - kraken_v1's ink still Dazes on his draws'; this pairs gullinbursti_v1 (stone_fist's self-feeding Sharp pile) against kraken_v1 as the Dazed applier - swap seats if you'd rather feel the reverse.   [you: gullinbursti_v1 | opponent: kraken_v1]
